body.description: Gateway Hotel, a newly opened Dubai hotel on the strip, offers 180 modern air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen TVs, minibars, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, complimentary toiletries, and a bidet. Some rooms offer tea/coffee facilities and a refrigerator. Hotel amenities include an outdoor pool, a fitness center, a sauna, a 24-hour business center, concierge services, babysitting (surcharge), a restaurant serving international cuisine, a coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Free self-parking is available. The hotel is conveniently located a 5-minute drive from the Dubai Metro Green Line, 700 meters from the Dubai Museum in Al Fahidi Fort, and within easy reach of numerous attractions including Meena Bazaar, Textile Souk, Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum House, Grand Mosque, The Dubai Heritage Village, SMCCU Sheikh Mohammed Centre for Cultural Understanding, Dubai Creek, Spice Souk, Deira Spice Souq, BurJuman Mall, Gold Souk, Dubai Cruise Terminal, Mina Rashid Marina, and Al Seef. Dubai International Airport is 7 km away.;The Gateway Hotel is a City hotel hotel. Located in Bur Dubai area. The nightlife/restaurants are right next to the hotel.
